_comment: Deep Context Toolkit configuration. Copy to config.json and customize.

privacy._comment: Global privacy filters applied across all extraction sources.

extraction._comment: Per-source extraction settings. Disable sources you don't use by removing them or setting enabled: false.

gmail._comment: Gmail extraction via Google OAuth. Requires gmail.readonly scope.

slack._comment: Slack workspace extraction. workspaces matches keys in OWNER_CONFIG.slackIdentifiers / SLACK_BOT_TOKEN_<NAME> env vars. `extract slack` runs three passes: your messages (from:), threads where you're @-mentioned, and any full-capture channels in tools/slack-capture-config.json.

beeper._comment: Beeper (unified messaging) extraction. Requires Beeper Desktop API enabled.

groupme._comment: GroupMe extraction via REST API (token-only, no app). Requires GROUPME_ACCESS_TOKEN. First run should use `extract groupme --backfill` for full history, then it goes incremental.

twitter._comment: Twitter/X archive import. Download your archive from x.com/settings and set archive_path to the extracted directory.

podcast._comment: Podcast transcript extraction. Set enabled: true and provide path to an episodes CSV if you have a podcast.

enrichment._comment: OPTIONAL AI enrichment (quality/topics/sentiment per message) via Gemini — needs GEMINI_API_KEY; skipped cleanly without one. DEEP_CONTEXT_ENRICH_MODEL overrides model. All schema fields must be marked required (Gemini silently drops optional fields). public_sources = the only sources export-public will ever copy.

synthesis._comment: Higher-quality model for summary synthesis and strategic analysis. Any current Gemini model works; use a 'pro' tier for best quality. These are just defaults — override per your access.
